entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you okay with heading into[n]Mementos today?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We conquered another Palace, so we[n]should be able to go deeper in now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's fine. You don't have any plans for[n]today, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right! That's the kind of response[n]I was looking for!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just come on. You'll be fine!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, make sure you let the rest of the team[n]know too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And tell them it has to be today!
